verified_rules.composition_tree_up_nodes: vU, child-transport v1/v2, and compare/full-set v nodes are up nodes
verified_rules.join_node: stored ordinary H/V path determines whether printorder recurses left or right
verified_rules.up_node: stored extension path admits a monotone selected-source-index sequence used to expand each output interval into source intervals
verified_rules.shrink_node: recurses to its unique child with the same interval index
verified_rules.zero_boundary_leaf: paper explicitly allows the corresponding factor to be placed at the beginning
verified_rules.root: printorder is called over all intervals of the chosen root trajectory
